caveats: Measured. Every PSD uses 512-point Welch windows (or fewer for a short record, as in the printed figures) interpolated onto one log-frequency grid; blank cells are frequencies a record cannot resolve.

The 'new stand' records are short (0.66 s and 0.15 s): their low-frequency end and their 100 Hz line are coarsely resolved. The 0.15 s 'fan on' record cannot resolve the 90-110 Hz line at all, which is why its 100 Hz displacement is reported as n/a.
The quiet conditions sit on the sensor's own noise floor (80 ug/sqrt(Hz) measured vs 90 datasheet), so differences between them below that floor are not vibration.
